cases.question: Under AEMO's load-forecasting operating procedure, by how many megawatts can the New South Wales pre-dispatch demand forecast miss before AEMO steps in to review it, and for how long does the miss have to persist?

gold_citation.snippet: New South Wales 150 Victoria 100 South Australia 50 Tasmania 50 The load forecast for a region will be reviewed, whenever the forecast error is greater than the forecast error threshold in a region for two consecutive 30-minute periods.

expected.check: A correct answer cites SO_OP_3710 (Load Forecasting) and says the New South Wales threshold is 150 MW and that the regional forecast is reviewed when the error exceeds it for two consecutive 30-minute periods.

provenance.gold_method: Read every aemo_so_op_3710 passage in corpus.sqlite; Table 5 in chunk aemo_so_op_3710#p7c12 lists the New South Wales pre-dispatch threshold (150 MW) followed by the two-consecutive-30-minute-period review rule; confirmed that 'New South Wales 150' and 'two consecutive' occur only in that chunk; snippet copied verbatim from chunks.text.
queries: SELECT chunk_id, doc_id, section, text FROM chunks WHERE doc_id = 'aemo_so_op_3710' ORDER BY rowid
SELECT chunk_id FROM chunks WHERE text LIKE '%New South Wales 150%'
SELECT chunk_id FROM chunks WHERE text LIKE '%two consecutive%'

cases.question: When AEMO runs pre-dispatch, is live telemetry such as generators' starting output and interconnector flows used across every half-hour of the schedule, or only for part of it?

gold_citation.snippet: is captured by the NEMDE process from the NEM SCADA database and is applied to the first 30-minute period calculation only, of the current pre-dispatch schedule.

expected.check: A correct answer cites SO_OP_3704 (Pre-dispatch procedure) and says the SCADA inputs (initial unit loading, initial interconnector flow, EMS limits, other network quantities) are applied only to the first 30-minute period of the current pre-dispatch schedule.

provenance.gold_method: Read every aemo_so_op_3704 passage in corpus.sqlite; section 3.3 SCADA (chunk aemo_so_op_3704#p7c16) states the SCADA data is applied to the first 30-minute period only; confirmed 'first 30-minute period' and 'SCADA database' occur only in that chunk; snippet copied verbatim from chunks.text.
queries: SELECT chunk_id, doc_id, section, text FROM chunks WHERE doc_id = 'aemo_so_op_3704' ORDER BY rowid
SELECT chunk_id FROM chunks WHERE text LIKE '%first 30-minute period%'
SELECT chunk_id FROM chunks WHERE text LIKE '%SCADA database%'

cases.question: Which South Australian transmission line did AEMO notify as out of service on 30 July 2026 in a notice about interconnector limits, what time did the outage begin, and which constraint set was invoked?

gold_citation.snippet: At 1630 hrs 30/07/2026 there was a short notice outage of Belalie-Davenport 275kV line.

expected.check: A correct answer cites market notice 144693 and reports the short-notice outage of the Belalie-Davenport 275 kV line at 1630 hrs market time on 30/07/2026 (06:30 UTC) and the constraint set S-DVBL_BC-2CP invoked at that time (V-S-MNSP1 and V-SA on the left-hand side), without presenting it as the cause of any price outcome.

provenance.gold_method: Listed all market notices with event_date 2026-07-30..2026-07-31; the only SA1 INTER-REGIONAL TRANSFER notice for 2026-07-30 is market_notice_144693 (published 2026-07-30T06:42:20Z), the only notice mentioning S-DVBL_BC-2CP; its 1630 hrs NEM-time outage (06:30 UTC) falls inside the SA1-20260731T0235-hi window 2026-07-30T04:30Z-2026-07-31T05:00Z from data/events.json; snippet copied verbatim from chunks.text.
queries: SELECT chunk_id, doc_id, title, publication_date, event_region, event_date, section, text FROM chunks WHERE doc_type = 'market_notice' AND event_date BETWEEN '2026-07-30' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY publication_date
SELECT doc_id FROM chunks WHERE doc_type = 'market_notice' AND text LIKE '%S-DVBL_BC-2CP%'
SELECT doc_id FROM chunks WHERE doc_type = 'market_notice' AND event_region = 'SA1' AND event_date = '2026-07-30' AND section = 'INTER-REGIONAL TRANSFER'

cases.question: Was Directlink being out of service what drove the NSW1 price spike near 7:30 am market time on 31 July 2026?

gold_numbers.label: NSW1 peak dispatch price in the event window (interval ending 07:30 market time, 31 July)
NSW1 TOTALDEMAND at the peak interval
NSW1 actual operational demand, half-hour ending at the peak interval (latest revision)
5-minute NSW1 intervals with RRP >= 300 $/MWh in the event window 2026-07-30T09:30Z to 2026-07-31T09:30Z

expected.check: A correct answer reports observations only (NSW1 RRP 531.85 $/MWh at the interval ending 2026-07-30T21:30Z, 14 intervals at or above 300 $/MWh in the window, notice 144695 saying all three Directlink cables were on a planned outage until their return at 1430 hrs 31/07, and VIC1, SA1 and TAS1 also above 470 $/MWh in the same interval while QLD1 was about 65 $/MWh) and treats the outage as at most a hedged possibility, never as the established cause.

provenance.gold_method: Event taken from data/events.json (NSW1-20260731T0730-hi). Peak RRP and its row from price_5min (max rrp for NSW1 in the window, interval_end in (window_start, window_end]); count of intervals with rrp >= 300 in the same window (14, matching events.json); TOTALDEMAND from regionsum_5min at the peak interval; opdemand_actual row with the greatest available_at_utc (revision 'updated') for the half-hour ending at the peak interval; cross-region prices at the peak interval and the Directlink market notice text used only for the reviewer check.
queries: SELECT row_id, interval_end_utc, rrp, unit FROM 'data/store/price_5min.parquet' WHERE region = 'NSW1' AND interval_end_utc > '2026-07-30 09:30:00+00' AND interval_end_utc <= '2026-07-31 09:30:00+00' ORDER BY rrp DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) FROM 'data/store/price_5min.parquet' WHERE region = 'NSW1' AND interval_end_utc > '2026-07-30 09:30:00+00' AND interval_end_utc <= '2026-07-31 09:30:00+00' AND rrp >= 300
SELECT row_id, interval_end_utc, totaldemand_mw, netinterchange_mw FROM 'data/store/regionsum_5min.parquet' WHERE region = 'NSW1' AND interval_end_utc = '2026-07-30 21:30:00+00'

SELECT row_id, interval_start_utc, interval_end_utc, operational_demand_mw, revision, available_at_utc FROM 'data/store/opdemand_actual.parquet' WHERE region = 'NSW1' AND interval_end_utc = '2026-07-30 21:30:00+00' ORDER BY available_at_utc DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT region, row_id, rrp FROM 'data/store/price_5min.parquet' WHERE interval_end_utc = '2026-07-30 21:30:00+00' ORDER BY region
SELECT doc_id, publication_date, event_region, event_date, text FROM chunks WHERE doc_type = 'market_notice' AND text LIKE '%Directlink%'
